subject: Private endpoint egress inventory + hosted-proxy ownership
messages:
From: acmehealth-security@acme.com
To: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: list of outbound IPs, proxy flow, and firewall owner for private endpoint

Hi Camila —

We are finalising our perimeter firewall rule review for the Redwood private runtime deployed in our VPC. For SOC/compliance signoff we need: a) definitive list of IP addresses (and CIDRs) that Redwood private endpoints might egress from, b) whether outbound flows for model calls traverse a hosted proxy maintained by Redwood or the customer, and c) an explicit owner at Redwood for firewall exceptions/rotations.

Can you send an inventory and a short statement of ownership/ops contact?

Also, if there are any short-lived/ephemeral IP ranges (and rotation cadence) please note that separately.

Thanks —
Amy Zhang
Security Engineer, Acme Health
From: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
To: acmehealth-security@acme.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: list of outbound IPs, proxy flow, and firewall owner for private endpoint

Hi Amy —

Thanks for the clear ask. I can pull together an inventory and a brief owner statement today. Two quick clarifications so we scope correctly:
1) Do you want IPs for both control plane and runtime egress (control plane = telemetry, licensing; runtime = model inference token traffic)?
2) Are you accepting a CSV with columns (component, ip/cidr, stable|ephemeral, rotation-window) + a single-page ownership contact stub?

I will loop in our ops lead for ownership confirmation.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Marissa / Laura —

Forwarding Acme's request. They want a short, authoritative inventory for their perimeter team. Can you please own the facts and reply-back by EOD? Proposed split below — adjust if you prefer: 

- Marissa: compile runtime/control-plane IP list and label each as stable vs ephemeral. Include any NAT/bastion exit IPs we expect for their VPC connector.
- Laura: confirm: who is the Redwood on-call/team that owns firewall exceptions, rotation cadence for ephemeral pools, and whether we require the customer to route through our hosted proxy (if applicable). If hosted-proxy is not used, state that outbound model traffic goes directly from runtime through customer's NAT/egress and list required destination FQDNs and port numbers.

Please attach the CSV and a one-paragraph owner statement for Amy to ingest into their audit. I have drafted a CSV template (attached).

Attachments: safelist_inventory_template.csv (stub)

Thanks —
Camila
From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme Health — inventory + ownership for private endpoint egress (action)

Camila —

I can take the runtime/control-plane IP inventory. Preliminary notes:
- Control plane (telemetry/auth): stable set: 34.223.10.0/24, 34.223.11.0/24 (region-us control-plane pool).
- Runtime (model inference): for Dedicated/private connectors, we typically rely on customer's NAT egress for inference traffic; however, where customers use Redwood-managed egress (hosted-proxy), we provide an outbound proxy pool. For this customer I checked and they requested the connector to use customer NAT (no hosted-proxy).
- Ephemeral bursts: we have short-lived scaling egress IPs for auxiliary tasks (ephemeral out 52.11.0.0/16) rotated nightly (approx 24h window) for batch/async workers — note these are not used for live inference when connector is pinned to customer NAT.

I'll populate the CSV and mark each row with 'stable' or 'ephemeral' and include rotation note. Laura — please add the ownership paragraph (who to contact for exceptions + on-call).

-Marissa
Director, Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: acmehealth-security@acme.com, camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: list of outbound IPs, proxy flow, and firewall owner for private endpoint

Amy / Acme Security team —

Please find attached: 1) safelist_inventory_acme.csv (columns: component, ip_cidr, stability, rotation_window, notes), and 2) hosted-proxy-design-slide.pdf (one-page summary of when Redwood-managed egress is used vs customer NAT). Summary: 

- For your deployment we will not route inference traffic through a Redwood-hosted proxy; outbound inference uses your VPC NAT. Required destinations (to allow from your NAT):
  * runtime.redwood-inference.internal (FQDN) — HTTPS (443)
  * telemetry.redwood-inference.internal — HTTPS (443) [control-plane only]

- Stable control-plane IPs: 34.223.10.0/24, 34.223.11.0/24; ephemeral auxiliary pool: 52.11.0.0/16 (rotation ~24h).

- Ownership: Firewall exceptions and rotation coordination are owned by Redwood Partner Ops. Primary contact: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com). For after-hours or rotation emergencies: PagerDuty: Redwood-Prod-Ops (link in attachment).

If you need us to instead enable Redwood-hosted-proxy for centralized egress (we can do this but it requires a short config change and adds a small egress IP dependency), let us know and we will provide a definitive fixed-proxy IP set and SLA.

Attachments: safelist_inventory_acme.csv (attached), hosted-proxy-design-slide.pdf (attached)

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Senior Network Architect | Redwood Inference
